description: Prepare a stock, crypto, or options trade instruction as a link, for requests such as "Buy 10 shares of Apple". A trade link is not a live order: it opens Trade It in the browser, where the user reviews, edits, and submits it through one of their connected brokerages. This tool never places, changes, or cancels an order.

action.description: Whether a simple trade buys or sells. Set when trade_type is 0.

amount.description: How much a simple trade buys or sells,, as dollars or shares per unit.

direction.description: Net cash flow of a multi-leg trade: debit when paying, credit when receiving, even for zero-net.

legs.description: Legs of an options or multi-leg trade. Set when trade_type is 1.

action.description: Whether the leg buys or sells.

occ.description: OCC option contract symbol, e.g. 260717C00435000. Null for stock legs.

position_effect.description: Whether the leg opens or closes a position.

quantity.description: Number of option contracts, or shares for a stock leg.

type.description: Whether the leg trades an option or the underlying stock.

limit_price.description: Limit price in the asset currency for limit and stop_limit orders; per spread unit for multi-leg trades, where 0 with direction even means zero-net.

order_type.description: How the order is priced. Omit for a market order.

stop_loss.description: Stop-loss exit for  bracket Buy entries or OCO Sell orders. Not supported by all brokerages.

unit.description: Absolute price ($) or percent from entry price (%).

stop_price.description: Price in the asset currency that triggers stop and stop_limit orders.

take_profit.description: Take-profit exit for bracket Buy entries or OCO Sell orders. Not supported by all brokerages.

unit.description: Absolute price ($) or percent from entry price (%).

ticker.description: Ticker symbol of the asset, or the underlying for options, e.g. TSLA

time_in_force.description: How long the order stays open: day expires at market close, gtc stays open until canceled. Omit to use the brokerage default.

trade_type.description: 0 for a single buy or sell using action, amount, and unit; 1 for an options or multi-leg trade using legs and direction.

unit.description: Whether amount is a dollar value or a share count.

utm_referred.description: Referral source label stored with the link for tracking, e.g. a newsletter name.

name: create_trade_link
title: Create Trade Link
